notes: Kernel setup excluded except explicitly timed influence_precompute. Dense/sparse have identical samples, writes and full-buffer checksum consumption. Affine avoids trajectories. Paired route-walk/influence screens consume identical numeric outputs; potential influence rows preserve canonical cost order. Retained validation is five runs, not the full batch. Overlapping phases do not sum to total search. No global optimum or universal speedup claim.

phases.name: dense_sampled_kernel
phases.scope: all candidates, 120 dense incidence/Euler steps, full trajectory writes and consumption
phases.allocation_scope: prebuilt topology/numeric inputs and reusable workspace; no allocation instrumentation

phases.name: sparse_sampled_kernel
phases.scope: same samples/outputs/consumption as dense; sparse edge updates
phases.allocation_scope: same preallocation as dense; no allocation instrumentation

phases.name: affine_screen_kernel
phases.scope: retained previous production route-walk endpoint/storage/shared-destination/cost screen; historical cost-only consumption; no sampled trajectories or final validation
phases.allocation_scope: prepared production topology/candidate buffers/workspace; no allocation instrumentation

phases.name: influence_precompute
phases.scope: construct control-influence map and reusable workspace once, consume numeric preparation checksum; allocation/destruction and checksum included
phases.allocation_scope: map/workspace allocations included; common Prepared and candidate input preparation excluded

phases.name: route_walk_screen_kernel
phases.scope: previous route-walk endpoint/storage/shared-destination/cost screen with full numeric-output consumption; same rows and outputs as influence_screen_kernel
phases.allocation_scope: prepared topology/candidate buffers/reusable workspace; no allocations in candidate loop

phases.name: influence_screen_kernel
phases.scope: precomputed control-influence endpoint/storage/shared-destination screen and cost estimate; potential rows recompute original-order canonical cost; same rows and full numeric-output consumption as route_walk_screen_kernel
phases.allocation_scope: map, candidate buffers and workspace preallocated; map preparation excluded

phases.name: reference_validate_retained
phases.scope: independent validate() on retained dense runs; excludes compile/simulate

phases.name: public_search_total
phases.scope: evaluate_candidates() automatic workload dispatch: preparation, bounds, selected screen, ranking, retained compile/dense simulation/validation and result materialization; selected evaluator recorded per case
phases.allocation_scope: all public API allocations and destruction included

phases.name: route_walk_search_total
phases.scope: previous evaluator through shared production search: preparation, bounds, route-walk screen, ranking, retained compile/dense simulation/validation and result materialization
phases.allocation_scope: same public-style API allocations and destruction as public_search_total
